chapter: Early life and New York years
title: Birth, college, Navy and learning to play by ear
summary: Born 1926 in California, he took cornet lessons at nine, served in the Navy, collected records, and taught himself to play by ear.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: We were talking earlier, and I'd like to get you placed in your age and everything. When's your birthday?

Oh, it comes in September every year, whether I want it to or not. Born in 1926. My college years, grew up in California. My college years started 1943. I had to go in the Navy in 45, 46, then got back to college and started chasing people like Kid Horry, because I was a pretty serious jazz record collector by that time, and spent a lot of time trying to soak up the music. I had taken cornet lessons when I was nine years old. Never was very distinguished. The school music teacher would always put me in the farthest back row in the very last chair and hoped that I wouldn't show up. Later on, though, there was something in me that wanted to come out, and I started playing on my own. I never could read music. I could barely spell music, as the expression goes. I can point to the note, and I'll tell you what it is, but that's as far as it goes. But I started trying to translate what I was hearing on these recordings and from these good musicians that I was able to hear like Horry. I found that I could turn around and reproduce it to a degree. And that's how it all started.
